title: Twilio Disabled-config branch (AC7) has no test
detail: AC7 requires a Twilio callback received while Twilio is Disabled to be rejected as unverifiable (403), not crash. The Disabled arm at webhooks.gleam:146 is exercised by no test.
recommended_fix: Add a test posting /webhooks/twilio-sms with config.twilio = sms_client.Disabled; assert 403 and no reference_call/audit/notification mutation.

--- grep for twilio redelivery/idempotency tests: "(none found)". Only resend_redelivery_is_idempotent_test (reference_checks_webhooks_integration_test.gleam:123) exists; no twilio_redelivery_is_idempotent_test.
detail: Idempotency is integration-tested for Resend only. Twilio's deliberate sid+status key (Dev Note 4) — so failed then undelivered for one message are distinct events — has no redelivery test; a regression to sid-only keying would pass all current tests.
